Title: BBCode in quotes - Firefox (was wrong, actually ...)

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:

Ah.. I think I found why .. I was concerned about bold + italic:
bold + italic = bold italic
different from
>

> not-bold quoted
>
(on my firefox, the difference between these last two quoted lines is very thin).
